page.overview:
Who is Ernst Stavro Blofeld?

Ernst Stavro Blofeld is the head of the global criminal organisation SPECTRE. Based on the Thunderball character of the same name, he appears in the novel's non-Eon film adaption, Never Say Never Again (1983), and is portrayed by Swedish actor Max von Sydow. Von Sydow was one of eight men to have played the iconic role of Blofeld on screen, and the only one to do so in a non-Eon film.

After years of profitable ventures in terrorism, extortion, kidnapping and drug trafficking, the criminal secret organization SPECTRE, headed by its founder and leader Ernst Stavro Blofeld, ventures into its most ambitious endeavour yet. Blofeld has devised a plan to steal two nuclear missiles from NATO in order to extort from the member states a kind of annual "terrorist tax" equal to the equivalent of twenty five percent of their oil purchases.

In doing so, he brings in USAF officer Captain Jack Petachi, whom they have hooked on heroin in order to control him. At Blofeld's instructions, a complicated surgical procedure has been performed on Petachi's right eye, in order to make his retinal pattern identical to that of the President of the United States of America, thus giving him access to American nuclear warheads.

While planning and coordinating the operation as Supreme Commander in the security of SPECTRE headquarters, his immediate subordinate Maximillian Largo is tasked with ensuring smooth implementation. This includes eliminating any company secrets, suchas Captain Petachi after he has served its purpose.

Also known as: Number 1.
